lines.native: I'm Marginalia. Esta es la historia de Journathan, el hombre de muchas lenguas. Su viaje a casa dura veinte años. I sell books to people who understand them. Radical policy, I know. ¿Adónde va Journathan?
lines.translation: I'm Marginalia. This is the story of Journathan, the man of many tongues. His journey home lasts twenty years. I sell books to people who understand them. Radical policy, I know. Where is Journathan going?
lines.narrative: At The Old Bookshop, a bookworm emerges from a hole in the stock. The remaining books bear her annotations; so, apparently, does the customer ledger.

lines.native: Un libro es a book. Journathan is not going to a book, though I respect the ambition. Not a pass yet. Listen for his destination: «Su viaje a casa dura veinte años». ¿Adónde va Journathan?
lines.translation: A book is a book. Journathan is not going to a book, though I respect the ambition. Not a pass yet. Listen for his destination: “His journey home lasts twenty years.” Where is Journathan going?
lines.narrative: Marginalia pencils a small question mark beside you. The pencil has clearly held this position before.

lines.native: Correct destination, wrong language. Not a pass yet; the footnote remains open. La respuesta debe estar en español. ¿Adónde va Journathan?

lines.narrative: Marginalia pencils a small correction in the air beside you. Apparently, you have margins.

lines.native: ¡Correcto! Journathan va a casa. Reading comprehension: recovering nicely. Ahora escucha: «El Cíclope le pregunta su nombre. Journathan responde: «Mi nombre es Nadie.»» The first recorded translation trick. No spoilers; the Cyclops has suffered enough. ¿Qué nombre le da Journathan al Cíclope?
lines.translation: Correct! Journathan is going home. Reading comprehension: recovering nicely. Now listen: “The Cyclops asks him his name. Journathan replies: ‘My name is Nobody.’” The first recorded translation trick. No spoilers; the Cyclops has suffered enough. What name does Journathan give the Cyclops?
lines.narrative: Marginalia ticks the margin beside your name. The pencil appears relieved to have found employment.

lines.native: Journathan es su nombre real. Pero ¿qué nombre le da al Cíclope? Not a pass yet. Correct man, wrong name tag. Lee el pasaje otra vez; la respuesta está en sus palabras.
lines.translation: Journathan is his real name. But what name does he give the Cyclops? Not a pass yet. Correct man, wrong name tag. Read the passage again; the answer is in his words.
lines.narrative: Marginalia pencils a small correction in the air beside you. Apparently, you now have margins.

lines.native: ¡Correcto! Journathan responde: «Mi nombre es Nadie». El Cíclope no sabe su nombre real. Comprendes el pasaje; el libro es tuyo. Reading comprehension: a respectable recovery. No spoilers, and please do not eat the footnotes. Those are mine.
lines.translation: Correct! Journathan answers: “My name is Nobody.” The Cyclops does not know his real name. You understand the passage; the book is yours. Reading comprehension: a respectable recovery. No spoilers, and please do not eat the footnotes. Those are mine.
lines.narrative: Marginalia stamps the receipt in a margin she has not yet eaten. The book is now legally someone else’s problem.

lines.narrative: Marginalia rides atop your pack at the market entrance, annotating a price tag for factual optimism. She opens a book with several well-eaten margins.

lines.translation: Very good! Yes, the story is lovely. Reading comprehension: approved. Do you want to hear the passage? Ask me in Spanish; my dramatic reading deserves a second audience, even if it is the first audience with better attention.
